title.zh: 分析：朝鲜IT劳工网络通过虚假身份渗透海外企业，相关加密资金流向Bybit等平台
title.en: 分析：朝鲜IT劳工网络通过虚假身份渗透海外企业，相关加密资金流向Bybit等平台

current_state.zh: SlowMist's on-chain analysis of the latest US Treasury-sanctioned North Korean IT labor network finds interlinked funding among the eight designated Ethereum and Tron addresses, with multiple transfers into Bybit and HTX deposit addresses, and warns firms to unify identity, device, outsourcing and access-control checks.
